name: AIR — Architecture Workspace
short_description: Design and review architecture dossiers with your AIR installation.
long_description: Official architecture workflow skills by Yannick Huchard. Install or connect an authorized AIR engine, then design, verify, simulate and prepare architecture deliverables. Requires a separately acquired AIR engine and project-specific MCP connection. No hosted AIR service or universal endpoint is provided. Engine repository access is currently restricted. Simulation describes modeled behavior, not a running business application.
starter_prompts: Connect an authorized AIR installation to this project.
Review this architecture dossier using the configured AIR registry.
Prepare architecture handoff materials from this AIR baseline.
release_notes: Initial public distribution of workflow skills, logo, license, public support and data-handling documentation. No shared MCP endpoint or engine access is included.
